_baselines: The five pictures e2e/visual.spec.ts holds the shell to (#227). They are not shipped and nobody drew them: each is a screenshot the CI runner took of this repository's own export, so their provenance is the run that took them and their licence is the repository's. Rule 3 asks every tracked image to say where it came from, and a baseline is a tracked image; this manifest is where it says so. When a baseline is updated (docs/visual-regression.md), update its run number here in the same commit — check-asset-licenses.mjs fails the build on a picture with no entry, and an entry that names a run the picture did not come from is a provenance claim that is false.
